title: KnowledgeSourceDescriptor
description: Declarative metadata for a Knowledge Source (KS). Loaded by Control without invoking the KS. NOTE: KSs are unaware of each other (canonical Blackboard rule). Ordering between KSs MUST be expressed exclusively through trigger predicates over Blackboard state — there is no `dependsOn` field.

writesPanel.description: The single Blackboard panel this KS contributes to.

writesSlots.description: Optional: panel-specific slot names this KS writes (e.g. 'archetypeRef'). Defaults to the panel's primary slot.

readsPanels.description: Panels this KS reads. Used by Control for parallelism analysis. NO transitive KS coupling: a KS reads Blackboard state, never another KS.

triggerPredicate.description: Tiny declarative DSL over Blackboard state. Read-only; no side effects, no method calls. May reference: panel kind, presence of resolved panel values for an identity, signals on SourceInterpretations, set membership. Example: 'panel == Statement && resolved(Archetyping, identity) && !contributedBy(self, identity)'.

appliesToInterpretationKinds.description: Optional filter for KSs whose trigger inspects SourceInterpretation.kind (e.g. ['CodeUnit', 'JpaEntity']). Used by Control for fast eligibility pruning; semantically equivalent to a check inside triggerPredicate.

parallelSafe.description: If true, Control may invoke this KS in parallel with other parallelSafe KSs whose readsPanels/writesPanel do not conflict on overlapping SubjectIdentities.

resolverHint.description: Optional advisory: this KS author believes this resolver fits its panel/slot best. Control's effective resolver = (RunConfig override) > (KS hint) > (engine default for that panel).

defmanReadScope.description: If defmanExplorationNeeded, the engine restricts DefManExplorationService to these archetype URIs.

implementationClass.description: Fully-qualified Java class name implementing the KnowledgeSource interface.
